metadata.title: How I Actually Find Curative Title Leads
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
In this episode of the Messy Money Podcast, Courtney Fricke breaks down how she actually finds curative title leads and ownership problem opportunities in today’s Real Estate market.

Instead of chasing the same overcrowded lead lists as everyone else, Courtney explains why some of the best deals come from marketplace inefficiencies, abandoned processes, overlooked public records, and problems other investors simply do not know how to solve.

ATTENTION:
The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.

Connect with Courtney Fricke: 
Instagram: https://instagram.com/courtneyfricke
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@courtney.fricke 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/courtneyfricke19/

Website: www.CourtneyFricke.com for more resources.

If you found this convo helpful, please subscribe to Courtney's Podcasts:
